source: SP 20.13330.2016 Section 11: the mean component wm = w0 k(ze) c with k(ze) = k10 (ze/10)^2α of the terrain types A, B, C, ze by the building's proportions (11.1.5), the pulsation wp = wm ζ(ze) ν (11.1.8, for f1 > flim), c 0.8 windward and -0.5 leeward (B.1.2), γf 1.4 in the combinations. The dynamic factor ξ of flexible buildings (f1 < flim, 11.1.10) and the peak pressures of cladding (11.2) are not covered: the parent's cladding and roof coefficients are used (named BNBC 2020).

A.description: Type A: open coasts of seas, lakes and reservoirs, deserts, steppes, tundra

B.description: Type B: urban areas, forests and terrain evenly covered by obstacles over 10 m high

C.description: Type C: urban areas with buildings over 25 m high

sources.exposures: SP 20.13330.2016 11.1.6, Table 11.3: k(ze) = k10 (ze/10)^2α, A: α 0.15, k10 1.0; B: 0.20, 0.65; C: 0.25, 0.4 (as Kz = kzFactor (z/zg)^(2/alpha) with zg 10 m and alpha = 1/α); k at least that at 5 m (A, B) and 10 m (C) as Table 11.2's first row (A 0.75 there: 0.81 here, on the safe side, U); Table 11.4 ζ at 10 m: A 0.76, B 1.06, C 1.78, ζ(ze) = ζ10 (ze/10)^-α
sources.topographic: Flat terrain (SP 20 11.1 has no topographic factor for buildings): 1.0
sources.gust: Not an SP value (P): G 1.7 ≈ 1 + ζ(20 m, B) ν (0.92 × 0.76) only for the parent's roof and wall pressures that take the table's gust; the storey forces take 1 + ζ(ze) ν of the pulsation
sources.cpWindward: SP 20.13330.2016 Appendix B.1.2, Table B.2: ce 0.8 on the windward wall
sources.cpLeeward: SP 20.13330.2016 Appendix B.1.2: ce3 -0.5 (-0.4 to -0.6 by b/l and h/l, one value taken, U)
sources.referenceHeight: SP 20.13330.2016 11.1.5: ze = h for h <= d; d and h below and above for d < h <= 2d; d, z and h for h > 2d, d the windward width (SAEngine's EN 1991-1-4 7.2.2 form, the split of the middle case at z = d: U)
sources.pulsation: SP 20.13330.2016 11.1.8: wp = wm ζ(ze) ν, ν of Table 11.6 by ρ = b and χ = h (Table 11.7), bilinear between (U); for f1 < flim (Table 11.5) the dynamic factor ξ is not applied (U)
